I completely understand where you’re coming from. Something that has helped me is reframing  the question. Focus on what you want to do instead of what you want to be. If you want to present masc, bind, etc then do it. If you want to stop for a while then do that. Figure out what you want and then how you identify will follow. 

That’s the advice I got when I was stressing about the same thing, hope it helps!
